data.job_title: Electronics Engineer Embedded Systems, Sensing & Control Hardware
data.additional_information:
Electronics Engineer
Embedded Systems, Sensing & Control Hardware
Location: Hyderabad / BBSR / Site-Based Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
Every data stream that feeds Fluxion's AI systems begins with a sensor correctly specified, installed, and communicating reliably.
Every actuation command our models generate must be executed by a control system that is safe, deterministic, and auditable.
The electronics engineer owns this layer entirely.
We are deploying sensor networks at port terminals, instrumentation on steel plant equipment, and embedded control systems for
AGVs and automated handling machinery. You will be involved in hardware selection, embedded firmware oversight, and field
commissioning from early in your role. Industrial environments are electrically noisy, physically harsh, and unforgiving of
specification errors.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Sensor selection and specification: LiDAR, computer vision cameras, RFID readers, thermocouple and RTD arrays, vibration
sensors, and industrial communication modules
– Embedded systems design and firmware oversight for edge compute nodes, sensor hubs, and control interfaces on microcontroller
and SoC platforms
– Industrial communication protocols: Modbus, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, OPC-UA, and CANbus — learning to work with these in
real plant environments
– PCB review and hardware bring-up for custom sensor integration boards and signal conditioning circuits
– Field commissioning and calibration of instrumentation at port and industrial sites, including characterisation in high-noise
environments
– Hardware reliability analysis: MTBF estimation, environmental protection ratings, and maintenance intervals for deployed systems
– Coordination with software and systems engineers on data acquisition architecture and real-time pipeline interfaces
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in electronics, electrical, or instrumentation engineering from a recognised institution
– Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, or hardware prototyping — lab and project work counts, not just
theory
– Understanding of at least one industrial communication standard or signal conditioning approach at a practical level
– Familiarity with basic EMC principles and electrical safety considerations for industrial environments
– Any exposure to SCADA, PLC, or DCS systems through internship or coursework is a strong advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
